# Casco

Casco builds websites with AI. https://casco.studio/

## Website build payment

Customers pay 18 USD or 180 USD once for their website code and the work of building their website.
That amount is not paid again to keep the site online. The site stays up and working, but they cannot update the code with AI.
Details: https://casco.studio/pricing
